Subject: Scheduling evaluation: trial plan, success criteria & demo slot

Hi Riley / Avery —

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and clear fit around using Redwood Inference for the model-serving layer in your pricing engine. Quick recap from our call: 
- Primary use case: low-latency scoring for user-level price personalization (95th pct latency target ~80ms).
- Data: pre-tokenized logs + feature vectors stored in Formula Data's S3 (US region).
- Success metrics: latency at 95th pct, inference cost per 1k requests, and qualitative coverage on edge prompts.
- Constraints: need SOC 2 scope + contract language confirming no customer PII retained on hosted logs.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff where we walk through a proposed trial plan, align on explicit success criteria, review a sample prompt set/evals, and schedule a technical deep-dive (model variant, quantization options, infra).

I have two slots available this week — would either work for your team?
- Tue Apr 20 • 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed Apr 21 • 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Suggested kickoff agenda (30/60):
- 10 min: goals & success criteria (Formula Data speaks)
- 20 min: trial plan review (data access, sample prompts, duration, success metrics)
- 20 min: technical owners / next steps / calendarize deep-dive

Requested prework (if possible):
- Quick list of 5 highest-priority prompts or scoring examples (we can map metrics to them)
- Any must-have compliance/security items for SOC 2 scope (we'll have our security lead on the follow-up call if needed)

Attendees we suggest from our side: myself (SE), Marissa Cole (Customer Success), Mina Haddad (Infra/Quantization). Please let me know who from Formula Data should join (security/infra/product).

I've attached a draft trial plan and a sample prompt set to make the kickoff efficient.

Thanks —
